conguagli.rule: Future changes must preserve the same 285 associations, not only the count.

rate_ordinarie.rule: Use two-decimal monetary precision. A residual exactly equal to EUR 0.01 is not an unpaid ordinary installment under the protected > 0.01 rule.

source_order.rule: Displayed people must follow the relative row order of the current Incassi sheet; source row is an ordering clue only, never a persistent identity key.

crediti_compensazioni.rule: Only ordinary/conguaglio credits remain in the V1 operational flow; they stay separate, unselected by default, and never auto-compensated.

selezione_voci.rule: Every V1 debt item remains individually selectable; totals recalculate from selected V1 items only.

ordine_condomini.rule: Drive folders remain ordered with Italian locale ordering.

drive_sync.rule: AGGIORNA scans Drive first, clears only archive/sync accounting data inside a recoverable transaction, reloads every valid balance, runs V1 self-check/deep-check before commit and restores the previous archive on any acquisition or validation error. Contacts, history and config are fingerprint-checked as unchanged.

whatsapp_contatti.rule: A saved phone number must not be inherited by a different owner/name or another unit of a duplicate owner.

v1_focus.rule: Operational UI, totals and WhatsApp messages contain only ordinary installments and conguagli; extraordinary/individual expenses and their unrelated credits remain outside V1.

runtime_self_check.rule: Every full Drive refresh must compare displayed order and ordinary items with the current Incassi source, verify conguaglio source totals/resolution, reject summary rows, validate unit identity, verify fresh archive data and show a final pass/fail report.

deferred_not_in_v1: Polizze, lavori, pignoramenti, inverter, autoclave, arretrati straordinari and similar sheets
Email and messa in mora are hidden from the V1 operational UI but retained in code for future reactivation
